items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 5 at 2:56PM PST until November 10 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to elevated
surf up to 4 to 6 feet expected, except likely higher around
Monday.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches.

* WHEN...From late tonight through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore. Pooling of sea water is possible around high tide at
beach and harbor areas that is uncommon with normal tidal
ranges. Enhanced beach erosion is also possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS....High tides of 7.2 to 7.6 feet (MLLW) are
expected each morning. Surf and coastal flooding impacts peak
on Monday, when a High Surf Advisory and Coastal Flood Advisory
is likely to be issued.
items.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.
